description:
Turn your Windows PC into a Noderr micronode and earn NODR tokens.

The Noderr Micronode is the entry tier of the Noderr Protocol. Run it on your Windows PC to contribute overhead compute to the AI agent mesh network, build on-chain TrustFingerprint reputation, and earn NODR tokens as the network routes work to you. No minimum stake and no special hardware are required. The node runs quietly in the system tray, and your wallet key never leaves your PC.
